_comment: B10 — how a payment is entered in eCW (docs/b10_posting.md). Each value is a choice the clinic confirms; where the September recordings and the November flow disagree, the note says so.
_amount: approve_to_pay = the EOB's approved amount, without Blue Shield's interest. Whether a check with interest takes the approved amount or the check total is still open (Vignesh is checking, 2026-11-25).
_received_date: tracker = Date Check Received from Karina's Insurance Check Tracker; when the tracker has none, the deposit date is used (Vignesh, 2026-11-25).
_deposit_date: tracker = the tracker's Deposit Date, else Blue Shield's cashed date. 'cashed' uses the portal's cashed date only (the recordings).
_facility: select = pick the one office location (the November flow). 'leave' = leave it empty (the recordings).
_attach_eob: Attach the EOB in the Payment Advisory window (Scan, Add, the file, OK).
_commit_buttons: The button that commits the typed lines; the first one found on the screen is pressed, and the log lists every button the screen offered. Vignesh's B10b demo (2026-11): 'Post payment', then OK. The September recordings: Auto Post (F2), then Yes. A check for several claims uses Save and Next per claim (B10c).
_set_claim_status: Set claim status BEFORE clicking Post Payment (Vignesh, 2026-11-25) — any denied line: ERA Payer Denied; no denial but a deductible, coinsurance or copay: Patient; nothing owed: Paid in Full.
_post_denied_lines: false = a claim with a denied line is held. The reason code to enter is the one printed on the EOB (e.g. PI 16) — confirmed 2026-11-25; the Blue Shield EOB reader does not read it yet (a sample EOB with a denial is needed).
_multi_claim_checks: false = a check that pays several claims is held for a person. true = 'Add Ins Payment (F3)', the payer chosen in the insurance lookup, each claim typed and committed with Save and Next (the B10c call). Written from the call, not yet run.
_post_zero_eobs: false = $0 EOBs are listed and held. true = Type 'Non Payment Data', the EOB number as the check number, one date in all four boxes (the B10b call). The portal walk must list them first (include_zero).
